long_description.before:
Alchemize helps teams review and test code written by humans and coding agents.

Agentic coding has 10x’d code output. Teams are opening larger PRs more frequently, but existing review workflows have not kept up.

Alchemize breaks large changes into smaller, dependency-ordered PRs and guided reviews. It shows the prompts and intent behind agent-written code, then uses browser agents to test affected workflows. Reviewers can quickly understand how a change works, what the agent assumed, and where human judgment is needed. Teams ship faster with more confidence.
long_description.after:

Agentic coding has 10x’d code output, creating larger PRs more frequently, but existing review workflows haven’t kept up. 

Alchemize breaks large changes into smaller, dependency-ordered PRs and guided reviews. It surfaces the prompts, intent, and assumptions behind agent-written code, then uses browser agents to test affected workflows.

Reviewers can quickly understand how a change works, identify where human judgment is needed, and ship faster with more confidence.

long_description.before:
We're building AI Passport, a personal memory layer that works across AI apps. Every AI product you use today keeps its own memory of you: ChatGPT has one, Claude has one, and every AI-powered app is starting to build one too. None of them talk to each other, you can't see most of what they've stored, and you re-explain yourself to each new tool.

AI Passport replaces those scattered profiles with one card you own. Your preferences, history, and goals live in one place, and new information lands in an inbox where you approve or reject it before it's saved. Apps that want to use your context request a pass, which grants them access to only the categories you allow and can be revoked at any time. Receipts show you exactly which app read what, and when.

For a user, this means any AI app can know you from the first message. 
For a business, personalization works in both directions: a storefront can retrieve a customer's taste, sizes, and budget and personalize instantly instead of running an onboarding quiz, and a support organization can keep one memory of each customer across tickets, teams, and agents, so every new case starts with what the company already knows about the person.
long_description.after:
The bottleneck for consumer AI is shifting from the model to the personal context that model uses. 

Models are already capable of completing most tasks for the average user, but consumer AI products still starts cold and have to rebuild an incomplete picture of the same user before they can personalise well. 

We’re building AI Passport so users can carry the personal context they create through everyday apps into new products, allowing those products to understand them from the first interaction instead of reconstructing the same incomplete picture from scratch. Users decide which parts of their context can move between products, while companies receive better information about their users.

Apps integrate AI Passport through a “Sign in with AI Passport” button, then request specific information for a stated purpose and duration rather than receiving broad, permanent access to everything the Passport holds. The user chooses what to share and can revoke access later, which makes the system particularly useful for sensitive health or financial context that may be valuable for a specific interaction but should not remain available indefinitely.

To support this permission model, AI Passport uses our own vector database as its memory backend, built for fast, compact per-user memory and cryptographically enforced access control. 

We’re building first-party apps that give people reasons to create and use their Passport now, while also integrating it into consumer products with existing audiences across hospitality, travel, finance, and lifestyle.

one_liner.before: User-owned memory and preferences that work across every AI app
one_liner.after: Secure, user-owned context for every AI app

long_description.before:
Glen is unified context for every agent and human on your team. Most MCP tools hand an agent a slice, one Slack thread, a single diff, and leave it to stitch the rest together itself. Glen reads from where your work already lives, code and PRs, issues, docs, and meetings, reconciles it, and gives your agents the full picture instead.

With Glen a coding agent knows why a line was written, not just what it says. Ask a PR assistant anything about a change and the clarifying-question relay disappears. Bug bots read the intent behind the code before they comment, so they stop flagging deliberate choices as defects and stop repeating mistakes they already made. A sales agent can coach your head of sales off the full account history, how teammates handle similar calls, what was promised, where the deal stalled, etc. 

As the work gets done, Glen also distills it into skills and offers them back to the next agent, or person, who hits the same task.
long_description.after:
Glen is the layer that unifies every agent your company runs. Glen pulls in agent sessions from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, plus Slack messages, GitHub prs, tickets, docs and calls. When a new agent picks up a task, Glen finds relevant prior context and injects it in the agents context window to steer it, producing knowledge work that is significantly higher quality, faster and cheaper.

Glen does more. You can query the original agent behind any line of code, or search every session your org has ever run. It distills what your team does into skills and surfaces the right one automatically. Agents work multiplayer, picking up the style and context of whoever else is on the file. Transcripts are unified across Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, so you can hand a session from one to another mid-task. And Glen can also double as a company brain, from Slack, in app, or by just installing Glen on any agent.

one_liner.after: Institutional knowledge for every agent in your company.

long_description.before:
Resumes made careers readable. LinkedIn made them searchable. Pluto makes them understood.

Professionals talk to Pluto for 10 minutes about what they’ve done, what they’re great at, and what they want next. Pluto makes that context discoverable to the right people and AI agents, helping them understand the professional more fully.

For hiring, companies tell Pluto who they want to meet. Pluto searches its network and the broader market, evaluates fit on both sides, privately confirms interest, and makes warm introductions when both sides want to connect.

18K+ professionals have shared their career context with Pluto. 50+ companies, from fast-growing startups to decacorns, use Pluto to meet people with deeper context and confirmed interest.
long_description.after:
Resumes made careers readable. LinkedIn made them searchable. Pluto makes them understood.

Professionals spend 10 minutes talking to Pluto's voice agent about what they've done, what they're great at, and what they want next. Pluto turns that into a structured picture of who someone actually is, capturing the competency and intent that resumes and LinkedIn don't.

When companies and AI agents go looking to hire, Pluto makes the right people discoverable.

25K+ professionals have shared their career context with Pluto, and 50+ companies, including Mercor, Warp, and Rho, use it to find and reach the right people. Long term, we're building the professional data layer AI agents will use to understand and find people.

We manufacture Nori: A sub-$2000 bimanual mobile manipulator that can clean rooms, restock shelves, and fold clothes. Nori can handle basic tasks out of the box, and its software lets anyone teach Nori to automate work specific to their home or business. 

Nori aims to solve the robotics data bottleneck. By deploying affordable robots to customers around the world, we can gather the diverse data required to train the next generation of generalist robotic policies. Every user of Nori makes Nori smarter.

Since launching 6 weeks ago we have already deployed our first robot and have over 200k in sales.

We can bring general-purpose robotics to homes and businesses that could never afford it before. There are 132.7 million households and 8.4 million employer business locations in the U.S. At $1,688 per robot, selling just one Nori to 0.5% of them represents a $1.2B market opportunity in the U.S. alone.

long_description.before:
Denta is dental insurance. As a full stack carrier, Denta makes insurance 25% cheaper by selling plans directly to employers and processing claims instantly with AI.

Everyone knows how bad health insurance is, dental insurance is worse. In healthcare, there is a law that insurance companies must spend 80% of premiums on patient care. In dental, where no such law exists, insurance companies spend as low as 60%.

The American dental insurance market is $100B/year. It is inevitable that Denta will insure every American and give that $40B back to employers, patients, and dentists.
long_description.after:
Denta is dental insurance. As a full stack carrier, Denta makes insurance 30% cheaper by selling plans directly to employers and processing claims instantly with AI.

I grew up in the back offices of my dad’s 10 dental practices, spent my high school years answering patient calls, and college building and selling software to over 300 dentists. Given my entire life will go to this industry, I am now solving its biggest problem: insurance.

Everyone knows how bad health insurance is, dental insurance is worse. In the US, dental insurers collect $100B per year. Despite the $25B of that spent on administration, it still takes insurers three weeks to pay claims with paper checks that Denta can pay electronically in seconds.

Denta will insure every American, sparing patients and dentists the $25B burden of dealing with legacy carriers.

🦋 Content in every language. The speakers' performances, preserved. Movies & TV, Broadcasts, Education, Ads, Platforms, Live Shopping.

Founders An Zhu Liu, Mingi Kwon, and Xu Zheng lead a team of PhDs, professors, and researchers from the world's top universities who started the field of joint audio-visual human models and co-authored the current state of the art in real-time human animation.

They started with video language translation, and they've already built one of the most accurate translators available today, the only one that works in real time. Everyone else scaffolds separate models and pre-processing; a world model just understands -- what the speaker means, from voice, person, and scene together. That's why the dub keeps the speaker's own voice, face, and delivery.

Vs ElevenLabs: they lose the laughter, the music, the ambiance -- 270% more background-sound error -- and ours sounds 27.8% more like you. Vs human translators: 100.3% of their quality -- scalable, real time. Published benchmarks: https://thefamiliarlab.com/benchmark

The $14B spent on dubbing every year flips to AI once it's good enough -- most of it movies and TV, the traditional dubbing heartland. Live multiplies it.

long_description.before:
If your team uses Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex to ship, you've felt it: the AI is great at writing code, mediocre at debugging it. When something breaks in prod, you're back to grepping logs, adding console.logs, redeploying, and hoping the AI's guess is right.

HyperProbe fixes this. Your coding agent dynamically drops non-breaking probes into your running services, straight from your IDE. When a probe fires, HyperProbe captures and sanitises the exact variable state, feeding your agent real evidence instead of flat logs. 

This fixes prod incidents in minutes from the exact same window where agents write code, without ever redeploying to add a print statement. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction. 

Built for backend teams shipping AI-written code today. Install in 60 seconds, see your first investigation in 10 minutes. That's why we call HyperProbe the runtime data layer for AI-native software.
long_description.after:
With tools like Cursor and Claude Code, writing software is no longer the bottleneck. Debugging is. Agents cannot fix production crashes using logs and traces that were sized for human eyeballs. The gap is missing data.

HyperProbe allows agents to debug live software autonomously. Our SDK drops non-breaking probes straight into running services to read exact variable states from memory at the moment of failure, instead of reasoning backwards from flat logs.

Zero redeploys. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction.

We turn 4-hour production war rooms into 10-minute automated resolutions. As agents write and operate more of the world's software, HyperProbe is the runtime observability layer that lets them understand what they built.

one_liner.before: Your coding agent writes code. Now let it fix prod too.
one_liner.after: The runtime data layer for agents to monitor and debug apps

long_description.before: Conifer is one app that connects you to every AI model (local and cloud) and automatically routes each request to the cheapest model that accomplishes your goal. Most requests run free on your own hardware, so teams cut their AI bill by ~80% while replacing a dozen provider contracts with one interface and one invoice. For sensitive material like financials or user data, a secure mode pins everything on-device with no external API calls.
long_description.after: There are thousands of models, providers, and harnesses, each with its own pricing and strengths, leaving an overwhelming number of choices when it comes to managing token spend and intelligence. Conifer uses intelligent routing and orchestration logic to handle the full path of each query: model selection, provider choice, and cache management. It all runs inside your existing harness, so tools like Claude Code and Codex work without changing your setup. By centralizing where inference occurs, Conifer lets companies save on their inference bill while leaving teams free to focus on what they are building.

one_liner.before: Local-first least cost routing system to reduce 80%+ token spend
one_liner.after: Least cost routing system to reduce 80%+ token spend
